key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual, over days to weeks. LOCATION: Chest (retrosternal or precordial). DURATION: Progressive over time. CHARACTER: Dull chest discomfort, pressure, or fullness. AGGRAVATING: Lying flat. RELIEVING: Sitting up, leaning forward. TIMING: Progressive worsening. SEVERITY: 3-6/10 discomfort. KEY POSITIVES: Recent pericarditis, malignancy history, uremia (kidney failure), hypothyroidism, autoimmune disease, muffled heart sounds, dyspnea. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT hemodynamic compromise (that's tamponade), NOT Beck's triad.
